proposed_followups.defect: Carried forward from batch1 (still open, not yet repaired): patent_landscape.json family n=19 ('reactive diluent packages for lowering VOC in epoxy coatings') is tagged cpc_ipc_class='C08G59/50; C09D163/00'. C08G59/50 resolves to the CPC 'Amines' curing-agent subgroup (under C08G59/40 'characterised by the curing agents used'), which contradicts the row's own described chemistry (an epoxide-side reactive-diluent additive, not an amine curing agent).
proposed_followups.proposed_done_criterion: Correct family n=19's cpc_ipc_class (and cpc_ipc_category) field from 'C08G59/50; C09D163/00' to the correct epoxy-compound-branch symbol, via a superseding patch (never rewrite in place) signed and cross-referenced in the module's RETRACTION-INDEX.md, with a re-verification that no other row shares the same C08G59/50-for-a-diluent-package error pattern.

proposed_followups.defect: Refinement to batch1's own proposed fix for row n=19: batch1 proposed correcting to C08G59/36 'together with mono-epoxy compounds', but C08G59/36 sits under C08G59/32 'Epoxy compounds containing three or more epoxy groups' (tri+-functional epoxy resins). This batch's full-subtree extraction of C08G59 (performed while adjudicating row n=55, the same reactive-diluent chemistry class) surfaced a second, more specific sibling symbol: C08G59/22 'Di-epoxy compounds' -> C08G59/223 '{together with monoepoxy compounds}'. Commercial high-solids marine epoxy coatings (row 19's and row 55's described chemistry) overwhelmingly use DGEBA/DGEBF-type DI-epoxy resins, not tri+-epoxy resins, so C08G59/223 is plausibly the more precise correct bucket than C08G59/36 -- neither this fire nor batch1 has confirmed which specific epoxy-functionality class the uncharted row n=19 family actually claims (the fixture's own text does not specify), so this is filed as an open refinement question, not a re-verdict of row 19 (which stands as adjudicated in batch1: definitely misassigned via C08G59/50, regardless of whether the correct fix is /36 or /223).
proposed_followups.proposed_done_criterion: Before repairing family n=19's cpc_ipc_class field, read the actual patent family(ies) underlying row n=19 (or, if the row remains an uncharted category-screen entry with no single family pinned, default to the CPC-scheme-correct general epoxy-compound-branch root C08G59/20) to determine whether the diluent chemistry is di- or tri+-epoxy-based, and select C08G59/223 vs C08G59/36 accordingly rather than assuming /36 by default.

source_provenance.extraction_method: grep -P '^<symbol>\t' against the official section text file; tab-delimited format is <cpc_symbol>\t<indent_level>\t<title_text>; title_text at indent>0 is elliptical and must be read against its ancestor chain (also extracted) per CPC Guide conventions.
source_provenance.note: This is the CPC SCHEME (symbol titles + hierarchy), the standard public artifact used to verify a classification assignment is defensible; it is not the longer prose 'CPC Definition' explanatory-notes document (FullCPCDefinitionXML), which was not required to adjudicate title-level faithfulness/misassignment for a bare category-screen row.
source_provenance.reuse_note: batch1's already-downloaded, hash-verified local copy of the same pinned zip/section files (cached at /tmp/cpc_audit/ on xbabe2) was reused for batch3 -- no new network fetch was required, same pinned edition.
source_provenance.source: Official CPC Title List bulk data (EPO/USPTO Cooperative Patent Classification)

theory_reference: Cooperative Patent Classification (CPC), joint EPO/USPTO scheme extending IPC (Strasbourg Agreement 1971, as amended); Guide to the CPC (EPO/USPTO); CPC Title List bulk data edition 202608.
